result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), covering beekeeping regulations, public swimming pool permits, and the City's Health Facility Revenue Bond Law, scraped from a code publisher page whose URL refers to a rent price-fixing division that is not included in this part.
result.notes: This part contains only beekeeping (""§§ 44.0411-44.0419""), swimming pool permit, and health facility revenue bond provisions of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 4. None of it concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The algorithmic rent-setting provision (§ 98.1103) named in the source URL does not appear in this part of the document, so no rule can be extracted from it here.
